svg.title: Player power against enemy scaling
svg.desc: One panel per configuration and slot. Player power is the highest standard reinforce level the stones received by that fill sphere can pay for, over +24. Enemy is the seed's own normalised regionSphereTargetRanges.
svg.text: Both series are percentages of their own ceiling, so they share one axis.
A curve that reaches the top early has no run left to climb.
